item.title: Offer a Wet-Weather Plan
item.audience: members of a weekend walking club
item.prompt_text: Your walking club planned an outdoor river walk on Sunday. Part of the path is now muddy after heavy rain. Suggest a shorter route through the covered market and tell the group where to meet. Explain one advantage and one drawback of the new route, and ask for a reply by Saturday evening.
item.target_grammar: First conditional; because, although and so; could for a proposal.
item.target_structure: State the change → give the route and meeting point → weigh one benefit and one drawback → ask for a reply.

checklist.point: Explain the problem with the original route.
Give a new route and meeting point.
Give a benefit and a drawback.
Ask for a reply by Saturday evening.
